verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe REST API, CLI, and webhooks for programmatic account interaction, but there is no dedicated 'export all your data in open formats' capability, data portability tool, or documented migration/export feature. Community commentary even highlights lock-in concerns (e.g., being 'locked into the Next.js ecosystem') and users switching to self-hosted alternatives to leave Vercel, but this doesn't constitute evidence of a working open-format export feature.
